run_finetune_retrieval: run the LaViLa model finetuning script for video-text retrieval on EK100 or Charades-Ego datasets
run_validate_mir: run video-text retrieval validation using mAP and nDCG metrics on the EK100 MIR dataset
run_validate_cls: run video classification validation using template-based zero-shot evaluation on the Charades-Ego dataset
run_train_epoch: run a single training epoch with gradient accumulation, mixed precision, and cosine LR scheduling
run_get_args_parser: run the argument parser to configure dataset paths, model checkpoints, and training hyperparameters
